text: {"lessons":["I sold 25 shares of Stock A at a gain, and the satisfaction was real; I should still decide whether to sell by my plan rather than by the pleasure of locking in a profit.","My account rose through Period 3, then fell sharply in Period 4 and continued to fluctuate; these short-term moves do not tell me what prices will do next.","I made no trades after Period 4 despite further account changes. I should review each position consistently, without letting loss aversion keep me from a sound sale or gains make me sell too quickly."]}
